content.text: In countries like Nigeria, Kenya, and Zimbabwe, platforms like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or unreliable. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-every-detail-you-6|Digital Product]] creators are left without a way to sell their products online. This guide shows you how to deploy a digital store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-webhook-driven-crypto-payment-fulfillment-what-actually-13|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]] Pages for free, using crypto payments. No platform restrictions. No subscriptions. Full ownership of your [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-4|infrastructure]]. By the end of this guide, you’ll have a fully operational store that accepts 300+ cryptocurrencies, processes payments automatically, and delivers products instantly. This is not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure built to last.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Cloudflare Pages provides free, globally distributed hosting with instant CDN delivery. Paired with Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and Supabase for order storage, this stack eliminates single points of failure. NOWPayments handles crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic webhook triggers. This architecture bypasses regional payment restrictions and currency instability. Unlike platforms that lock you in, this infrastructure is yours to own and control. It’s designed to withstand the same conditions that pressure-tested it in Zimbabwe—actual payment rejection, currency collapse, and financial isolation.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, ensure you have your digital products ready in a folder, a Cloudflare account (free), and a NOWPayments API key. If you’re using Stack 02, you’ll also need a Supabase account (free tier). Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint or opt for the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a fully deployed, end-to-end tested solution. No coding experience is required, but basic familiarity with GitHub and Cloudflare’s dashboard will streamline the process. This stack is built for creators who prioritize ownership over convenience.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring NOWPayments to accept your preferred cryptocurrencies. Use BSC, Solana, or TRON for transaction fees under $0.10. Set up a webhook to trigger product delivery once payment is confirmed on-chain. For delivery, upload your products to Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. Write a Cloudflare Worker script to verify payment and generate secure, time-limited download links. If using Stack 01, Google Apps Script can handle this logic. Test the pipeline locally before deploying to ensure payments trigger deliveries as expected.
Own your infrastructure—no platform can shut you down.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to Cloudflare Pages by connecting your GitHub repository. Once live, test the entire flow on the mainnet—place an order, confirm payment, and receive the product. Monitor the Supabase database to ensure orders are logged correctly. If using Stack 02, COREMERCH’s 48-hour deployment includes end-to-end testing before handoff. Promote your store only after verifying that the infrastructure handles real transactions flawlessly. This step is non-negotiable—your reputation depends on it.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your store live, focus on scaling traffic and product offerings. Add new products by updating your Cloudflare R2 bucket and modifying the backend logic in Cloudflare Workers. Use the scaling playbook in the Sovereign Blueprint to optimize performance as your customer base grows. For advanced features like email automation or analytics, integrate third-party tools via webhooks. This infrastructure is designed to scale with you, not against you. No platform limits. No unexpected shutdowns. Just sovereign commerce.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. It’s ideal for creators who want a free, quick deployment (4-6 hours). Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, offering more scalability and features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. COREMERCH deploys Stack 02 in 48 hours, fully tested and ready for production. Choose Stack 01 for simplicity or Stack 02 for enterprise-grade infrastructure.
Crypto payments bypass regional restrictions and currency collapse.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re ready to deploy Stack 02 without the hassle, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes full deployment, 5 products loaded, and end-to-end testing. For a DIY approach, explore the Sovereign Blueprint or start with Stack 01. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to compare stacks and choose the one that fits your needs. This infrastructure is built for creators who refuse to be locked out of global commerce.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Gather your digital products and create a Cloudflare account. 2. Set up a NOWPayments account and generate an API key. 3. Configure your payment pipeline to accept preferred cryptocurrencies. 4. Upload products to Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. 5. Write and test backend logic in Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 6. Deploy your store to Cloudflare Pages. 7. Test the entire flow on the mainnet. 8. Monitor Supabase for order logging. 9. Promote your store once infrastructure is verified. 10. Scale by adding products and optimizing performance.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this infrastructure if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Sovereign Blueprint provides step-by-step instructions, and the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes full deployment and support. No coding required.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are processed manually via your NOWPayments dashboard. Automate refund requests using Cloudflare Workers if needed.
Is this infrastructure secure?
Yes. Cloudflare’s global CDN and automatic SSL ensure security. Payments are verified on-chain, and product links are time-limited.
Can I switch from Stack 01 to Stack 02 later?
Yes. Migrate by transferring backend logic to Cloudflare Workers and data to Supabase. COREMERCH can assist with this transition.
Deploy once, scale infinitely—this is sovereign commerce.
